summary.content:
Today's selection covers 100 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 59 on Artificial Intelligence and 22 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Siri won’t be your AI girlfriend
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Maine breach portal abused to publish fake data breach disclosures
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, NY Times Tech, SecurityWeek, BleepingComputer, Krebs on Security and others
• **Fresh Content**: 43 articles published in the last 24 hours
